item.text:
The views suggest a straight U-channel with a constant, thin-walled section. I’ll use that profile and check its proportions and orientation in the preview.

[Open the CAD viewer](http://127.0.0.1:8771/#part.FCStd)

The revised preview matches the channel opening and face arrangement in all four views. Its proportions are close to the reference, and validation confirms a single solid. I’ll export the STEP file now.
